title: 收益率到5%：固定收益久期变香了，信用利差太紧，还能配吗？
speaker: Gareth Nicholson

segments.en: Well, then when we talk to a client like that, the first thing they want is their one stability. And they're very close up to that. They want regular income that they can feel like they're moving forward, so there has to be a high growth level.
segments.zh: 嗯，当我们与这样的客户交谈时，他们首先想要的是稳定性。他们非常接近这一点。他们想要稳定的收入，让他们感觉在前进，所以必须有一个高增长水平。

segments.en: Now, their growth level will differ from one client to their rest, but realistically, 78% is the number that people will settle on at least. So to get them, we need income assets, real assets.
segments.zh: 现在，他们的增长水平会因客户而异，但现实地说，78%是人们至少会接受的数字。所以为了达到这个，我们需要收入资产、实物资产。

segments.en: We like things that are going to build resilience, so when we build that core, we like having gold, we like having private credit, we like having private infrastructure, we like having inflation protection. That helps us build a core.
segments.zh: 我们喜欢能够建立韧性的东西，所以当我们构建核心时，我们喜欢拥有黄金、私人信贷、私人基础设施、通胀保护。这有助于我们构建核心。

segments.en: When it comes to the fixed income, we touched briefly before the 2026 remnants jumped in, about where yield is. Now, yield is 5% from the tenure. It's going to be interesting. Yield is 5.5% from the fifth year. I think you get a lot of pension funds that are going to start looking at that.
segments.zh: 谈到固定收益，我们在2026年残余跳入之前简要触及了收益率在哪里。现在，十年期收益率是5%。这将很有趣。五年期收益率是5.5%。我认为你会看到很多养老金开始关注这一点。

segments.en: So what I'm saying is we're almost at levels where fixed income duration in particular becomes interesting, and people will start investing there. But for a fully prospective, it's not just the treasure's duration, it's also the credits.
segments.zh: 所以我说的是，我们几乎到了固定收益久期变得特别有吸引力的水平，人们将开始在那里配置。但从全面角度来看，不仅仅是国债久期，还有信用。

segments.en: And where it's getting tricky and fixed income, and why we're expanding to many different parts of fixed income because you're getting paid that overall high yield, but your credit cushion, the credit spread, is very tight. So that means you don't have much resilience if you get any scare. You're typically like a higher credit cushion.
segments.zh: 固定收益变得棘手的地方，以及为什么我们扩展到固定收益的许多不同部分，因为你获得了整体高收益，但你的信用缓冲，信用利差，非常紧。所以这意味着如果你遇到任何惊吓，你没有太多韧性。你通常喜欢更高的信用缓冲。

segments.en: So this is why we're looking at a lot of ADS, CNBS, CLL, in the higher rate of space. These are still offering some interesting opportunities. So if I wanted to create a blank portfolio today, it would be a very flexible fixed income opportunity offering many different areas.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们在更高利率领域关注很多ADS、CNBS、CLL。这些仍然提供一些有趣的机会。所以如果我今天想创建一个空白组合，它将是一个非常灵活的固定收益机会，提供许多不同领域。

segments.en: It would be real assets. And then we'd be looking at equity, and equity, particularly focusing on a higher proportion outside of US. So we're liking EM. We're liking the Middle East. We're liking Asia, and particularly in growing stocks,
segments.zh: 它将是实物资产。然后我们会关注权益，权益，特别关注美国以外更高比例。所以我们喜欢新兴市场。我们喜欢中东。我们喜欢亚洲，特别是成长型权益，

segments.en: growing areas, like AI, we still like the space, energy, infrastructure. And that would give us our portfolio of average 80%. And then we have a high-growth areas we've planned once as well.
segments.zh: 成长领域，如AI，我们仍然喜欢这个领域，能源、基础设施。这将给我们平均80%的组合。然后我们还有高增长领域，我们也计划了一次。
